units.source_text: 匂亲王早有计虑：

en.t: Prince Niou had already made his plans:

units.source_text: 既然去了，当夜立即回京，倒不如不去的好。

en.t: if he went only to return to the capital that very night, it would be better not to go at all.

units.source_text: 但山庄中人目众多，颇感拘束，所以他预先布置好：

en.t: But there were many eyes at the villa, and he felt rather constrained, so he had arranged everything in advance:

units.source_text: 叫时方在对岸找一所屋子，准备带浮舟到那里去。

en.t: he told Tokikata to find a house on the opposite bank and prepared to take Ukifune there.

units.source_text: 时方比他先出发，在对岸安排好了，于夜深时分来山庄报命：

en.t: Tokikata set out ahead of him, made the arrangements across the river, and came to the villa late at night to report:

units.source_text: “一切都已准备。”

en.t: Everything is ready.

units.source_text: 右近在睡梦中被唤醒，不知道亲王要把小姐怎么样了，

en.t: Ukon was awakened from sleep and, not knowing what the prince meant to do with her young lady,

units.source_text: 非常狼狈，昏昏沉沉地前来帮忙，好像玩雪的顽童一般浑身发抖。

en.t: was terribly flustered and came to help in a daze, trembling all over like a naughty child who had been playing in the snow.

units.source_text: 匂亲王不让别人问明情由或提出反抗，只管抱了浮舟出门。

en.t: Prince Niou gave no one a chance to ask the reason or offer resistance; he simply took Ukifune in his arms and carried her out.

units.source_text: 右近只得留守在此，叫侍从跟着小姐前去。

en.t: Ukon had no choice but to stay behind, and sent Jijuu to accompany her mistress.

units.source_text: 匂亲王抱着浮舟上船，就是浮舟平日朝夕望见的那种冒险伶仃的小舟。

en.t: Prince Niou carried Ukifune onto the boat, the same frail, precarious little craft she had so often seen morning and evening.

units.source_text: 这船渡向对岸时，浮舟似觉离岸疾驶，遥赴东洋大海，

en.t: As the boat crossed toward the far bank, Ukifune felt as if it were racing away from shore toward the distant eastern sea,

units.source_text: 心中恐怖，只管紧紧地抱住匂亲王，匂亲王觉得非常可爱。

en.t: and in her terror she clung tightly to Prince Niou, who found her very endearing.

units.source_text: 此时天空挂着残月，清光照遍四方，水面明净如镜。

en.t: At that moment a waning moon hung in the sky, its clear light shining everywhere, and the water gleamed bright and pure like a mirror.

units.source_text: 舟子报道：“这个小岛叫作橘岛。”

en.t: The boatman said, This little island is called Tachibana Island.

units.source_text: 便暂时停船，以便欣赏。

en.t: So they stopped the boat for a while to enjoy the view.

units.source_text: 这小岛形似一大岩石，上面生着许多常青的橘树，枝叶繁茂。

en.t: The little island was shaped like a great rock, with many evergreen tachibana trees growing thickly over it.

units.source_text: 匂亲王对浮舟说：“你看这些橘树！

en.t: Prince Niou said to Ukifune, Look at these tachibana trees!

units.source_text: 虽然微不足道，但其绿色千年不变。”

en.t: Though they may seem insignificant, their green remains unchanged for a thousand years.

units.source_text: 便吟诗曰：

en.t: Then he recited a poem:
